title: VP defense pressed on P319M China remittances, P4.4B transactions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial defense lawyers of Vice President Sara Duterte have stressed “relatively smaller personal expenses” that she and her husband had incurred rather than address “bigger issues” — such as the alleged P319.33 million in remittances from China, including Hong Kong, and P4.4 billion in transactions they had from 2007 to 2025. Manila Rep. Joel Chua, a House prosecutor, pointed this out in a statement on Monday. Chua cited the testimony of Ronel Buenaventura, executive director of the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC), in October, when revealing that the vice president’s husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, had a 47.5 […]...
